dog.description_text:
What do you call a dapper, 6-year-old gentleman made of 48 pounds of hunka hunka bulldog muscle? PORKCHOP! Porkchop’s fosters describe him as the perfect houseguest. Appears to be house trained? Check. Walks well on a leash? You betcha. Sleeps like a baby in his crate? Yep, and he’ll throw in adorable bulldog snores, too. All that, plus this mushy faced guy loves everyone he meets. Dogs, familiar faces and new ones — Porkchop is a lover boy who wants to spread good vibes and bully snuggles to everyone he meets. To add the gravy on top, Porkchop has the cutest underbite we’ve ever seen! What are you waiting for? Apply today to bring this porky guy home forever!

Approved adopters interested in Porkchop can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not approved yet, apply today at hbrdogs.com.
